correctnessContracts.mechanism: A complete replayable read trace includes ordered selector reads, failed extension probes, resolved paths and compile-time effects; monotone discovery is local to one immutable attempt
correctnessContracts.openPremise: Prove read mediation and producer extensionality; finite trace completion is not semantic closure; dependency cycles require rejection or an independently proved evaluator
correctnessContracts.counterexample: Record chosen .scm only; a previously absent higher-priority extension appears, changing top-level source resolution
correctnessContracts.retirement: Broad dependencies retire only after complete managed read mediation; keep conservative invalidation for untracked effects
correctnessContracts.benefit: Avoid generation only outside the actual semantic read closure; shared fixnum remains 34 candidates
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Read/probe manifests, namespace identity, restart or suspend policy, retained failure traces

correctnessContracts.mechanism: Bind read image, resolved namespace, tool/profile and dependency output groups to one cohort; epoch invalidation and publication use one linearization authority
correctnessContracts.openPremise: All relevant writes must revoke authority before visibility; same epoch number does not prove isolation; no unmanaged-live-path fallback
correctnessContracts.counterexample: Read A before change and B after change; final A/B hashes restored by ABA; no coherent consumed input cohort
correctnessContracts.retirement: Live-path rereads and duplicate currentness decisions retire only inside a qualified snapshot owner
correctnessContracts.benefit: Prevent mixed-cohort publication; retain successful unchanged groups across unrelated attempt cancellation as historical only
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Immutable input storage, attempt leases, revocation serialization, staged group retention

correctnessContracts.mechanism: Consumer-specific extensional projections; generated C bytes for C compiler; parsed ordered full linker record including validated producer/target for metadata consumer
correctnessContracts.openPremise: Prove each actual consumer factors through its projection; the integer meta field is not a proof of actual targ-link-info equivalence
correctnessContracts.counterexample: Equal module names but changed supply/demand, flags or metadata; descriptor reused with changed initialization order
correctnessContracts.retirement: Timestamp-only dirty propagation and repeated descriptor emission retire only when edge observations are qualified
correctnessContracts.benefit: Stable linker observations can stop descriptor/linkfile propagation even if implementation bytes change
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Explicit producer/schema identity; parser parity; all-consumer coverage; exact equality or collision policy

correctnessContracts.mechanism: One successful manifest owns complete output group, names, mode, ordered side products and receipt; publish atomically through a manifest pointer, rather than claiming multi-file rename atomicity
correctnessContracts.openPremise: Prove successful producer exit, expected-group completeness, unique writer, retained-reader lifetime and crash recovery; Lean does not prove filesystem commit
correctnessContracts.counterexample: New metadata with old C after partial rename; output bytes unchanged but a required side product deleted
correctnessContracts.retirement: Repeated existence-based acceptance and scattered publication owners retire only after complete-group replacement
correctnessContracts.benefit: Reuse only required complete products; avoid rebuilding valid groups merely to repeat orchestration
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Staging, side-product schema, leases, atomic manifest authority, old-group reclamation

correctnessContracts.mechanism: Inject ten selected actions into a 74-action GSC slice; 31 omitted library modules and executable module remain explicit boundary vectors, never silently folded into one representative
correctnessContracts.openPremise: Related initial cache origins; ordered boundary observations; omitted-step stutter; simulation of selected transitions; full budget includes omitted running jobs; whole macro case violates frozen-boundary premise
correctnessContracts.counterexample: fixnum changes omitted _gsc.c while selected two-module model reuses executable linkfile; invalid stutter
correctnessContracts.retirement: Small-population acceptance cannot retire any whole-chain dependency; migrate all concrete targets and cross-directory callers
correctnessContracts.benefit: Precise population prevents false 34-to-2 or 74-to-10 savings; permits scoped leaf reasoning
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Per-target identity and ordered vectors; full parameterized scheduler/refinement still required

correctnessContracts.mechanism: Finite acyclic closed cohort, terminating producers, fair ready admission and shared weighted budget; retry work charged separately from validated nodes
correctnessContracts.openPremise: Discovery may restart arbitrarily; separate finite safety from liveness and work minimality; preserve recursive jobserver ownership
correctnessContracts.counterexample: Parent holds final token awaiting dynamically discovered child; or repeated invalidation prevents completion
correctnessContracts.retirement: Phase envelopes retire only after complete cross-directory dependency and child-drain proof; current within-phase jobserver remains
correctnessContracts.benefit: Cross-phase overlap reduces critical path only when independent jobs and credits actually exist
correctnessContracts.addedCost: Ready queue, suspend/restart policy, weight accounting, fairness/drain; no assumed measured speedup
